name: Amendments by the committee responsible – separate vote
title: REPORT on the proposal for a directive of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directives 2006/43/EC, 2013/34/EU, (EU) 2022/2464 and (EU) 2024/1760 as regards certain corporate sustainability reporting and due diligence requirements
part_text: The Commission shall, no later than 1 October 2028, conduct an assessment on the impact of reasonable assurance standards on the costs for undertakings, and the feasibility for auditors and for undertakings, and whether such standards provide a clear added value and contribute meaningfully to the sustainability efforts of the undertakings.
